```python
import simpa as sp
import numpy as np
import os

# Set up global simulation parameters
VOLUME_WIDTH_MM = 30
VOLUME_HEIGHT_MM = 20
VOLUME_DEPTH_MM = 30
SPACING_MM = 0.5
WAVELENGTHS = [700, 730, 760, 800, 850, 900]  # nm

SIMULATION_PATH = "simpa_tissue_simulation"
os.makedirs(SIMULATION_PATH, exist_ok=True)

settings = sp.Settings()
settings[sp.Tags.SIMULATION_PATH] = SIMULATION_PATH
settings[sp.Tags.VOLUME_NAME] = "tissue_volume"
settings[sp.Tags.WAVELENGTHS] = WAVELENGTHS
settings[sp.Tags.SPACING_MM] = SPACING_MM
settings[sp.Tags.DIM_VOLUME_X_MM] = VOLUME_WIDTH_MM
settings[sp.Tags.DIM_VOLUME_Y_MM] = VOLUME_HEIGHT_MM
settings[sp.Tags.DIM_VOLUME_Z_MM] = VOLUME_DEPTH_MM
settings[sp.Tags.RANDOM_SEED] = 4711

# Device setup
device = sp.InVision256TF()
settings.set_detection_geometry(device.get_detection_geometry())
settings.set_illumination_geometry(device.get_illumination_geometry())

# Function to create the tissue structure
def create_tissue_structure(settings):
    structures = []

    # Background
    background = sp.Structures.BackgroundStructure(settings, sp.TissueLibrary.soft_tissue())
    structures.append(background)

    # Muscle layer
    muscle_layer = sp.Structures.HorizontalLayerStructure(
        settings,
        z_start_mm=2,
        thickness_mm=10,
        molecular_composition=sp.TissueLibrary.muscle(),
        priority=1
    )
    structures.append(muscle_layer)

    # Epidermis layer
    epidermis_layer = sp.Structures.HorizontalLayerStructure(
        settings,
        z_start_mm=0,
        thickness_mm=1,
        molecular_composition=sp.TissueLibrary.epidermis(),
        priority=2
    )
    structures.append(epidermis_layer)

    # Blood vessel 1
    vessel1 = sp.Structures.CircularTubularStructure(
        settings,
        x_center_mm=10,
        y_center_mm=VOLUME_HEIGHT_MM / 2,
        z_center_mm=7,
        radius_mm=1.5,
        length_mm=VOLUME_WIDTH_MM - 10,
        molecular_composition=sp.TissueLibrary.blood(oxygenation=0.9),
        priority=3
    )
    structures.append(vessel1)

    # Blood vessel 2
    vessel2 = sp.Structures.CircularTubularStructure(
        settings,
        x_center_mm=20,
        y_center_mm=VOLUME_HEIGHT_MM / 2,
        z_center_mm=12,
        radius_mm=1.0,
        length_mm=VOLUME_WIDTH_MM - 10,
        molecular_composition=sp.TissueLibrary.blood(oxygenation=0.6),
        priority=4
    )
    structures.append(vessel2)

    return structures

# Add tissue structure to settings
settings.set_structure(create_tissue_structure(settings))

# Run the simulation
sp.run_simulation(settings, device=device)

# Linear unmixing
unmixing_settings = sp.Settings(settings)
unmixing_settings[sp.Tags.SIMULATION_PATH] = SIMULATION_PATH
unmixing_settings[sp.Tags.WAVELENGTHS] = WAVELENGTHS
unmixing_settings[sp.Tags.DATA_FIELD] = sp.Tags.OPTICAL_ABSORPTION_PER_CM
unmixing_settings[sp.Tags.UNMIXING_ALGORITHM] = "linear"
unmixing_settings[sp.Tags.UNMIXING_MOLECULES] = ["oxyhemoglobin", "deoxyhemoglobin", "water", "fat"]

unmixing = sp.LinearUnmixing(unmixing_settings)
unmixing.run()

# Load and visualize results
initial_pressure = sp.load_data_field(SIMULATION_PATH, sp.Tags.DATA_FIELD_INITIAL_PRESSURE)
unmixed = sp.load_data_field(SIMULATION_PATH, sp.Tags.DATA_FIELD_UNMIXED_ABSORBERS)

sp.visualise_result(initial_pressure, title="Initial Pressure")
for absorber in unmixing_settings[sp.Tags.UNMIXING_MOLECULES]:
    if absorber in unmixed:
        sp.visualise_result(unmixed[absorber], title=f"Unmixed: {absorber}")
```
